source.title: Neural substrates for expectation-modulated fear learning in the amygdala and periaqueductal gray

confidence_rationale: Single-unit recording in LA and PAG during fear conditioning: US-evoked responses in both are inhibited by expectation; PAG inactivation attenuates amygdala US responses and impairs fear acquisition. Causal evidence that an expectation-modulated aversive teaching signal from PAG instructs amygdala plasticity -- the event-taught character MECH-599 needs, and the PE trigger MECH-598 assumes. It is a Rescorla-Wagner-type signal, not associability.
failure_signatures: Instructive US signals to the amygdala are suppressed when the US is expected; a threat store taught by raw harm magnitude rather than by harm prediction error would keep strengthening on fully predicted harm, which this contradicts.
The teaching signal arrives via PAG; the amygdala does not generate its own aversive teaching signal, so a threat store must have an upstream PE source.

mapping.source_claim_statement: US-evoked responses of LA and PAG neurons are inhibited when the US is expected; pharmacological PAG inactivation attenuates US-evoked amygdala responses and impairs acquisition of fear conditioning, indicating PAG relays expectation-modulated instructive signals to the amygdala.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-599's store is 'taught by aversive-PE events'; this is the canonical causal evidence that the biological threat store's teacher is an expectation-modulated signal, not raw damage. That supports SD-020 / MECH-258 (harm enters as PE) and the claim's V3-EXQ-1109 motivation. For MECH-598 it supplies the trigger but not the associability.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The expectation modulation is Rescorla-Wagner: it modulates the teaching strength of the US, not the learning rate of the CS. Rat; auditory fear conditioning with footshock; the teaching signal's source in REE is undefined.
mapping.source_context: Rat, single-unit LA and PAG recording during auditory fear conditioning; PAG muscimol inactivation

confidence_components.notes: High quality: single units plus causal inactivation, Nature Neuroscience, replicated later by the same group (Ozawa 2017). Mapping stronger for MECH-599 than MECH-598.
